:::{#exr-score-second-moment}
#### Second moment of the score

Under the assumptions of @exr-score-mean-zero,
show that $\E{\score^2} = \einf(\param)$,
the [expected information](#def-einf).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-score-second-moment}

By @exr-score-mean-zero,
$0 = \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx$
for every $\param$.
Differentiate this identity with respect to $\param$;
the step that substitutes for $\deriv{\param}\p(\vx \mid \param)$ uses @exr-deriv-log-density:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\param} 0
&= \deriv{\param} \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(differentiate both sides)}\\
0
&= \deriv{\param} \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(derivative of a constant)}\\
&= \int \deriv{\param}\sb{\paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param)} d\vx
&& \text{(exchange derivative and integral)}\\
&= \int \paren{\frac{\partial^2}{\partial \param^2} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
 + \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \deriv{\param}\p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(product rule)}\\
&= \int \paren{\frac{\partial^2}{\partial \param^2} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
 + \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \paren{\deriv{\param}\log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{($\deriv{\param}\p = \paren{\deriv{\param}\log \p} \p$)}\\
&= \int \paren{\frac{\partial^2}{\partial \param^2} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
 + \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)}^2 \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(product of two equal factors is a square)}\\
&= \E{\frac{\partial^2}{\partial \param^2} \log \p(\vX \mid \param)}
 + \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)}^2 \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(definition of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hess} + \int \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)}^2 \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(definition of the Hessian)}\\
&= \E{\hess} + \E{\paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vX \mid \param)}^2}
&& \text{(definition of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hess} + \E{\score^2}
&& \text{(definition of the score)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Rearranging:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{\score^2}
&= -\E{\hess}
&& \text{(subtract $\E{\hess}$ from both sides)}\\
&= \E{-\hess}
&& \text{(move the constant factor $-1$ into the expectation)}\\
&= \E{\oinf}
&& \text{(observed information is the negative Hessian)}\\
&= \einf(\param)
&& \text{(definition of expected information)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
